open: A locked-off shot from a scripted feature film, a slow dark drama with made-up characters played by actors on a closed set. One continuous shot with no cuts. The camera is fixed and does not move.

clips.text: The gloved hand drives one screw into the top corner of the board with the drill, then presses the board flat against the brick with the heel of the hand and lets go. The lettering on the board stays exactly as it is. Rain runs down the window glass in the foreground. The street lamp flickers once. Nobody speaks. The only sounds are rain on glass, a cordless drill whirring briefly and a street lamp buzzing.

The woman's finger moves slowly down the page line by line and her lips move very slightly as she counts under her breath. After three seconds her finger stops, her eyes lift from the book toward the window on the right, and she holds perfectly still, looking out. Nobody speaks. The only sounds are a clock ticking and a page settling.

The two men heave the loaded pallet truck slowly sideways together, staying the same size in the frame, glaring at each other over the load with their jaws working. The crowd behind them keeps its backs turned. The red flare burns and pink and blue smoke drifts across the sky. Nobody speaks a word that can be made out. The only sounds are two men grunting and muttering angrily with no clear words, small steel wheels grinding on tarmac and a far-off crowd.

The two men hold their grins into the lens, and each gives the other's shoulder one slow squeeze. They do not blink for a long moment, then blink at different times. The grins stay exactly as they are. Nobody speaks. The only sounds are a studio lamp humming, a jacket creaking and a far-off door closing.

clips.full: A shot from a scripted feature film with made-up characters played by actors on a closed set, filmed on a cheap camcorder. One continuous shot with no cuts. The camera is hand-held and shakes slightly. The two men in front sway together with their heads back, laughing breathlessly with their mouths wide, and one slaps the other on the chest. Behind them the man with the glass drinks from it. The old man in the chair does not move and does not blink. The only sounds are wordless laughter, glasses clinking, canvas flapping in the wind and a generator humming. Nobody speaks. No music. Thanks.
